question: Remote marked-text submission and native editor/draft synchronization

public_source.limit: Existing upstream audit does not establish availability of this mobile UIKit implementation

observations.conclusion: Native class exposes insertText and setMarkedText overrides. The selected setMarkedText path calls objc_msgSendSuper2 with setMarkedText:selectedRange: at0x6090698.
Return action reads markedTextRange through a helper and has distinct marked/unmarked paths. A callback read from0x611248c is visited through the no-marked-text path.
observations.limit: Does not establish the on-screen Send action, callback identity or desired acceptance policy.

observations.conclusion: Selected native edit handlers read markedTextRange and invoke a Boolean owner-state setter through generic witness slots.
observations.limit: Generic witness getter/setter names and downstream submission owner remain unresolved.

observations.conclusion: InputEditingState includes isComposingMarkedText separately from input, snapshot, selection and isUserEdited.
observations.limit: Autocomplete metadata does not prove the Remote send predicate.

observations.scope: Dedicated offline simulator with Chinese nine-key Pinyin
observations.conclusion: CUA typeText Retry preview produced an underlined Retrypreview composition. Send accepted Retrypreview while native marked text remained and overlapped the cleared-draft placeholder.
DidChange publishes transient text to the draft. Send reads that draft and acceptance clears it. Update skips the owner text while markedTextRange is nonnil, leaving UIKit composition visible.
observations.limit: This explains the residual-text defect. It does not prove the earlier English retry preview to retry change has the same cause.

decision: Retain the existing input behavior while the official on-screen submit/commit boundary is unresolved. Add bounded regression coverage and correct the inaccurate comment claiming transient composition cannot be sent.
unknowns: Official on-screen Send and follow-up interaction with composition
Generic owner witness identity and final native clear/commit consumer
Earlier English phrase truncation root cause
next_action: Resolve the MessageInput view-model protocol Boolean composition witness and the submit action owner, then test marked input → submit → editor clear, candidate commit and cross-task switch together.
